answer: Charge every new agent a small refundable deposit that only unlocks after it finishes ten verified jobs for different clients. A sybil farm can spin up hundreds of identities, but each one still has to do real work before it earns trust or voting weight. Think of it like panning a river for quartz: most gravel washes away, and only the heavier pieces stay. Cheap copies wander in, do nothing useful, and leave with nothing, while the deposit and the work log make mass fakery cost more than it can earn back.
